Stage.LogText: {=da_log_2_1}Grim tidings reach your camp: the master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} has caught wind of an arson plot against his workshop, orchestrated by the vengeful merchant {RakipTuccar_Link}. Ride to his forge at once.
{=da_log_2_2A}You chose to stand vigilant over the workshop for 5 days. Keep your scouts posted and blades sharpened; the saboteurs will strike under cover of darkness.
{=da_log_2_2A_savas}Torches pierce the night! The rival saboteurs have assaulted the workshop perimeter. Crush them before the bellows are put to the torch!
{=da_log_2_2B}Rather than wait for flames to rise, you decided to sever the snake's head. Track down {RakipTuccar_Link} and put an end to this conspiracy.
{=da_log_2_2B_savas}{RakipTuccar_Link} refused to back down and unleashed his hired bodyguards upon you. Cut them down to assert your clan's will.
{=da_log_2_fail}Your forces were overwhelmed in battle! With no one left to stand between the merchant's cutthroats and the workshop, the ancient bellows were put to the torch.

Action.Title: {=da_inq_kalfa_fail_title}The Forge in Ashes
Action.Text: {=da_inq_kalfa_fail_text}The merchant's hired blades overpowered your warriors. Before dawn, columns of black smoke rose over the district as the ancient forge was burned to the ground.

Stage.LogText: {=da_log_2_3}The forge stands triumphant! In recognition of your steadfast protection and martial cunning, {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} confers upon you the Journeyman's Seal.

DialogNode.Text: {=da_kalfa_p_giris}I heard alarming rumors, master. What troubles your forge?

{=da_kalfa_dlg_1}A shadow hangs over the anvil, my friend. {RakipTuccar_Link} has gathered deserters and cutthroats to burn my workshop to the ground. If the hearth turns cold, the great blade shall never be finished. How shall we meet this malice?
{=da_k2_p_sorgu_lonca}How many generations has this forge stood, master? How dares a mere merchant scheme to burn so ancient a workshop?
{=da_k2_p_sorgu_taktik}How many saboteurs has he recruited, and from where do they plan to launch their torching?
{=da_k2_p_sorgu_hukuk}How do town magistrates and city guards tolerate such open lawlessness? Can we not call upon the town guard?
{=da_kalfa_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_k2_npc_lore_lonca}For three centuries this hearth has tempered the crowns of kings and forged the heirlooms of great houses. Yet when that merchant failed to extort our quenching fluxes and ancient dies, he vowed that what he cannot own shall turn to ash. He believes his coin can purchase impunity.

{=da_k2_npc_lore_taktik}Rumors say he hired over sixty cutthroats. In the dead of night, when watchmen are heaviest with sleep, they intend to scale the workshop eaves with pitch-soaked torches. If flames take the timbers, saving the bellows will be impossible.

{=da_k2_npc_lore_hukuk}The magistrates are fat with that merchant's bribes, child! In Calradia, when coin clinks, justice goes blind. If we wait for courts, our forge will be cold ash before a bailiff even writes a summons.
{=da_k2_p_sorgu_tahkimat}What defenses can we mount around the perimeter? How are we prepared against torches, master?
{=da_k2_p_sorgu_onleyici}Waiting for arsonists invites ruin. Where does this merchant keep his counting house? We must crush the viper in its nest.
{=da_kalfa_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_k2_npc_detay_tahkimat}We filled the cisterns and barricaded the courtyard. If you and your warriors keep a 5-night vigil, you can drown those saboteurs in the ditch before they ever light a torch.

{=da_k2_npc_detay_onleyici}He sits in the caravansary of the merchant quarter, flanked by forty hired spearmen. If you march directly upon him, you can tear up that foul contract before a spark is struck.
{=da_kalfa_p1}I shall post guards and keep watch over your workshop. No arsonist shall breathe within our perimeter.
{=da_kalfa_p2}Defense invites hesitation. I shall hunt down {RakipTuccar_Link} directly and break his will before the torches are lit.
{=da_kalfa_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_k2_npc_onay_savunma}I honor your steadfast resolve, warrior. Post your scouts around the perimeter and keep watch for five nights. If flames rise, our honor burns with them!

{=da_k2_npc_onay_saldiri}Bold words from a true warlord! Track down {RakipTuccar_Link} and force him to tear up that treacherous contract. Yet beware: the guards bought by his gold are seasoned sellswords.
{=da_kalfa_t_p_giris}We must settle the matter of your arsonists and the blacksmith's forge, merchant.
{=da_kalfa_dlg_2}Ah, the clan warlord barks! Commerce in this district belongs to those with coin, not ancient fossil smiths dreaming of bygone kingdoms. What brings you to my ledger?
{=da_k2_m_p_sorgu}Is burning a centuries-old craft and innocent lives truly worth securing a petty monopoly? Is this what Calradia's laws taught you?
{=da_k2_m_p_gozdagi}Your coin can purchase you naught but a shallow grave, merchant. If a single spark touches that forge, I shall turn your caravans to ash and your flesh to carrion.
{=da_k2_m_p_pazarlik}Every breath has its price in your ledger. What is the sum to call off your cutthroats and leave the forge unmolested?
{=da_kalfa_takip_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=da_k2_m_npc_sorgu}The law? Hah! Warlords extort tribute, lords gorge at banquets, and those with gold write the laws! That stubborn old smith refused to bow, so he must burn. Yet if you wish to close my ledger, either open your purse or let your steel speak!

{=da_k2_m_npc_gozdagi}Your tongue is sharp, but the spears of my forty hired mercenaries are sharper! You do not frighten me, warrior. Either compensate my lost profits, or leave your corpse in the gutter!

{=da_k2_m_npc_pazarlik}At last, someone who speaks sense! For the advance coin paid to the arsonists and my foregone weapon margins, I demand 2,000 gold. Hand over the coin and the torches are extinguished; refuse, and steel shall decide!
{=da_k2_m_p_baski}You boast of hired spears, but sellswords melt away when their master's throat feels cold steel. Do you truly wager your life on hirelings? [Roguery]
{=da_k2_m_p_finans}Two thousand denars is a fortune for a handful of cutthroats. What guarantee do I have you won't strike again next moon?
{=da_kalfa_takip_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_k2_m_npc_baski}Easy there, keep your hand off that hilt! The... the underworld whispers of your ruthlessness. Choose quickly then: coin, terror, or blood in the street?
{=da_k2_m_npc_finans}My signature upon parchment is binding across all guilds! Once gold touches my palms, I will burn that arson contract before your very eyes.
{=da_kalfa_t_p1}I offer you 2,000 gold. Call off your arsonists and let this feud end in profit.
{=da_kalfa_t_p2}If you don't recall your cutthroats this instant, your own bedchamber will taste cold steel before sunrise. [Roguery]
{=da_kalfa_t_p3}Words are wasted on treacherous vultures like you. Call your mercenaries, and let steel decide who governs this land!
{=da_kalfa_takip_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=da_kalfa_dlg_3_altin}Gold always speaks with greater eloquence than pride. Very well, I shall recall my mercenaries. The old fool may hammer in peace.
{=da_kalfa_dlg_3}B-by the gods, stay back! Lower your blade... I want no quarrel with bloodthirsty sellswords. The contract is canceled, I swear it!
{=da_kalfa_dlg_4}Insolent dog! Guards, seize this meddler and toss their corpse into the gutters!
{=da_sabotajcilar_dlg_intro}The merchant paid us well to turn that forge to ash! Step aside, or burn with the anvil!
{=da_sabotajcilar_p_savas}The only thing turning to ash tonight is your band of arsonists. Draw!
{=da_korumalar_dlg_intro}Our master wants your head on a pike! Cut them down!
{=da_korumalar_p_savas}Your master's gold cannot save you from righteous steel. To arms!
